name: Hilda
source:
Hilda is a member of the hero's party. She is the big sister of the party and is usually calm, but she can pack a powerful punch when she gets angry.

Hilda is a serious woman who holds herself up to high standards. She takes it upon herself to become a teacher for the amnesiac Hero and the people of the realm.
